rulings.text: R1 THREE-LAYER DELIVERY, verbatim: 'i think when you teach me through an analogy always give the real defination or real AI language answer as well so it sticks to my brain because just understanding and remembering by analogy is difficult for me ... after finishing the tokenization samjhao we will make this point in the document as well where all samjhao process contract and rules are written'

R2 JIRAH VOLUME, verbatim: 'i want to give as many jirah and re jirah possible for every topics which i am covering with maximum number of questions being asked but should be done when i fully understand the concept'

R3 NO RATTA, verbatim: 'my adhd pi brain will never remember the exact definations, i can not mug up answers (ratta nahi maar sakta mera dimag) isko bi dimag mein rakhna for all future sessions of samjhao as well and re jirah'. CONSEQUENCE: a correct answer is one where the MECHANISM is rebuilt, in whatever words arrive. Different words + right mechanism = BETTER, not worse. The technical line is a target shape, never a memorisation target.

R4 FREE FLOW, verbatim: 'doc one axis per day or one topic per day rule is stupid, it should be free flowing, do not try to control my adhd gifts, let it free flow.' CHECKED: no such rule exists. §5-4 TIME-BOX is a ceiling with a DEFER; §9 already says 'Do not underestimate his throughput ... Size turns to his pace.' Nothing changes; recorded because it is a live ruling.

R5 SCOPE, verbatim: 'i want god tier 10x level on steriods level for the entire field so for all topics whatever we will forever study from now onwards, i am here to dominate the market, not participate or compete in it.' Plus: 'do not underestimate my adhd gifts, i can go tunnel visioned in and can grind my ass off for 10 hours daily minimum.' Plus, standing and repeated: everything must work SESSION-AGNOSTIC.

GEMINI FLASH APPROVED for the cold-read falsification run (his word: flash is ok theek hain). Reasoning recorded: the quote-discipline predicate makes the test model-independent, so a WEAKER and more literal reader is more honest here — Pro with extended thinking would paper over the very gaps the test hunts for. Fabricated quotes are caught deterministically by a literal-substring check against the deep. LAW T extended-thinking-ON stays untouched because the predicate does the work, not the model.

HIS RULING, 22 Aug — NO TABLES, EVER. Verbatim: "never never use tables. Tables are very annoying for me. Like, I cannot understand things. Just just write it simply. You know? I don't know. Like table is something which which irritates my mind, to be honest." APPLIES TO: every teaching surface — samjhao, Re-Jirah, FORGE, session reports, and anything rendered for him. Prose and simple lists only. This is pedagogy/format, so under C6 the teacher owns it and it does not escalate; it is recorded here and receipted via acts.mjs at the axis boundary (C2).

HIS RULING, 22 Aug — NO ABSTRACT PROGRESS COUNTERS. Verbatim: "please drop this vague things like idea x out of y, i want to see the real terms and concept names that ok i am reading and learning this right now which is a part of this. i have adhd pi bro, don't forget it. my mind works differently." REPLACEMENT IN FORCE: position is shown as a NAMED CONCEPT inside its named axis inside its named topic (e.g. TOKENIZATION > AXIS b > SEQUENCE LENGTH + QUADRATIC ATTENTION COST), never as "idea 5 of 8". Note this does NOT weaken C7 (declare-then-serve-ONE-idea-per-turn) — the pacing law stands, only its LABEL changes.

HIS RULING, 22 Aug — THE TECHNICAL LAYER IS NOT OPTIONAL, restated by him as a complaint. Verbatim: "you are not giving me exact definitions as well. Right? To make it stick with the real words... I am getting the analogy I am understanding the hinglish which you are speaking, but I am not getting the real techy AI tech world languages." This is R1 (21 Aug) being enforced by him a second time: DUKAAN + ASLI NAAM + TECHNICAL LINE, all three, every idea. TEACHER ERROR THAT CAUSED IT: when he said "I understood nothing", I removed the term O(n squared) instead of opening it slowly — an over-correction. Names are never removed; they are opened.

HIS RULING, 23 Aug ~06:00 IST — REMOVE THE NO-DATE-COUNTDOWN LAW (§5 / DAILY_CADENCE HARD RULES). VERBATIM: "time has come now to remove this rule - §5, the no-date-countdown law. now its god tier 10x level on steriods level execution just like my clout people for the dominance level." WITH ITS CONTEXT, VERBATIM: "i have 6-8 weeks to prepare for everything at the level i dominate the entire market i mean at the end of week 7 i should be ready to apply in the market which is organsim s job anyways" and "see at the sprint file, reset all of the dates in it. i am starting now." RECORDED AS BINDING — his word outranks the architect s. NOT EXECUTED BY THIS LANE: the law is enforced in code in five places (brain, cortex, dugout prompt LAWS; manager s elapsed-not-countdown render; benchmark s selftest asserting no days-left string reaches a report) plus canon prose in four files, and §10-D rule 6 says a gate may only get stricter — so the mechanics are filed as Q-7 for the audit lane. I always want you to keep on thinking, keep on thinking, exhaust your thinking, think, think, rethink, metacognit on that, then rethink, imagine, visualize, and then finally give me the answer. VERBATIM: "always brainstorm with me first and let us together make the finalized conversation first after talking and taking the entire thought process to absolute rock bottom (no surface level thinking anywhere anytime) and then note down things for architect, this is for all of sessions inside claude code remember that."
